children.name: person
children.description: Grouping of person

children.name: person_id
children.description: a unique identifier for each person.

children.name: gender_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key that refers to an identifier in the concept table for the unique gender of the person.

children.name: year_of_birth
children.description: the year of birth of the person. for data sources with date of birth, the year is extracted. for data sources where the year of birth is not available, the approximate year of birth is derived based on any age group categorization available.

children.name: month_of_birth
children.description: the month of birth of the person. for data sources that provide the precise date of birth, the month is extracted and stored in this field.

children.name: day_of_birth
children.description: the day of the month of birth of the person. for data sources that provide the precise date of birth, the day is extracted and stored in this field.

children.name: birth_datetime
children.description: the date and time of birth of the person.

children.name: death_datetime
children.description: the date and time of death of the person.

children.name: race_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key that refers to an identifier in the concept table for the unique race of the person, belonging to the 'race' vocabulary.

children.name: ethnicity_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key that refers to the standard concept identifier in the standardized vocabularies for the ethnicity of the person, belonging to the 'ethnicity' vocabulary.

children.name: location_id
children.description: a foreign key to the place of residency for the person in the location table, where the detailed address information is stored.

children.name: provider_id
children.description: a foreign key to the primary care provider the person is seeing in the provider table.

children.name: care_site_id
children.description: a foreign key to the site of primary care in the care_site table, where the details of the care site are stored.

children.name: person_source_value
children.description: an (encrypted) key derived from the person identifier in the source data. this is necessary when a use case requires a link back to the person data at the source dataset.

children.name: gender_source_value
children.description: the source code for the gender of the person as it appears in the source data. the person’s gender is mapped to a standard gender concept in the standardized vocabularies

children.name: gender_source_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key to the gender concept that refers to the code used in the source.

children.name: race_source_value
children.description: the source code for the race of the person as it appears in the source data. the person race is mapped to a standard race concept in the standardized vocabularies and the original value is stored here for reference.

children.name: race_source_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key to the race concept that refers to the code used in the source.

children.name: ethnicity_source_value
children.description: the source code for the ethnicity of the person as it appears in the source data. the person ethnicity is mapped to a standard ethnicity concept in the standardized vocabularies and the original code is, stored here for reference.

children.name: ethnicity_source_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key to the ethnicity concept that refers to the code used in the source.

children.name: visit_occurrence
children.description: Grouping of visit_occurrence

children.name: visit_occurrence_id
children.description: a unique identifier for each person's visit or encounter at a healthcare provider.

children.name: person_id
children.description: a foreign key identifier to the person for whom the visit is recorded. the demographic details of that person are stored in the person table.

children.name: visit_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key that refers to a visit concept identifier in the standardized vocabularies belonging to the 'visit' vocabulary.

children.name: visit_start_date
children.description: the start date of the visit.

children.name: visit_start_datetime
children.description: the date and time of the visit started.

children.name: visit_end_date
children.description: the end date of the visit. if this is a one-day visit the end date should match the start date.

children.name: visit_end_datetime
children.description: the date and time of the visit end.

children.name: visit_type_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key to the predefined concept identifier in the standardized vocabularies reflecting the type of source data from which the visit record is derived belonging to the 'visit type' vocabulary.

children.name: provider_id
children.description: a foreign key to the provider in the provider table who was associated with the visit.

children.name: care_site_id
children.description: a foreign key to the care site in the care site table that was visited.

children.name: visit_source_value
children.description: the source code for the visit as it appears in the source data.

children.name: visit_source_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key to a concept that refers to the code used in the source.

children.name: admitted_from_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key to the predefined concept in the place of service vocabulary reflecting where the patient was admitted from.

children.name: admitted_from_source_value
children.description: the source code for where the patient was admitted from as it appears in the source data.

children.name: discharge_to_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key to the predefined concept in the place of service vocabulary reflecting the discharge disposition for a visit.

children.name: discharge_to_source_value
children.description: the source code for the discharge disposition as it appears in the source data.

children.name: preceding_visit_occurrence_id
children.description: a foreign key to the visit_occurrence table of the visit immediately preceding this visit

children.name: visit_detail
children.description: Grouping of visit_detail

children.name: visit_detail_id
children.description: a unique identifier for each person's visit or encounter at a healthcare provider.

children.name: person_id
children.description: a foreign key identifier to the person for whom the visit is recorded. the demographic details of that person are stored in the person table.

children.name: visit_detail_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key that refers to a visit concept identifier in the standardized vocabularies belonging to the 'visit' vocabulary.

children.name: visit_detail_start_date
children.description: the start date of the visit.

children.name: visit_detail_start_datetime
children.description: the date and time of the visit started.

children.name: visit_detail_end_date
children.description: the end date of the visit. if this is a one-day visit the end date should match the start date.

children.name: visit_detail_end_datetime
children.description: the date and time of the visit end.

children.name: visit_detail_type_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key to the predefined concept identifier in the standardized vocabularies reflecting the type of source data from which the visit record is derived belonging to the 'visit type' vocabulary.

children.name: provider_id
children.description: a foreign key to the provider in the provider table who was associated with the visit.

children.name: care_site_id
children.description: a foreign key to the care site in the care site table that was visited.

children.name: visit_detail_source_value
children.description: the source code for the visit as it appears in the source data.

children.name: visit_detail_source_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key to a concept that refers to the code used in the source.

children.name: admitted_from_source_value
children.description: the source code for the admitting source as it appears in the source data.

children.name: admitted_from_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key to the predefined concept in the 'place of service' vocabulary reflecting the admitting source for a visit.

children.name: discharge_to_source_value
children.description: the source code for the discharge disposition as it appears in the source data.

children.name: discharge_to_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key to the predefined concept in the 'place of service' vocabulary reflecting the discharge disposition for a visit.

children.name: preceding_visit_detail_id
children.description: a foreign key to the visit_detail table of the visit immediately preceding this visit

children.name: visit_detail_parent_id
children.description: a foreign key to the visit_detail table record to represent the immediate parent visit-detail record.

children.name: visit_occurrence_id
children.description: a foreign key that refers to the record in the visit_occurrence table. this is a required field, because for every visit_detail is a child of visit_occurrence and cannot exist without a corresponding parent record in visit_occurrence.

children.name: specimen
children.description: Grouping of specimen

children.name: specimen_id
children.description: a unique identifier for each specimen.

children.name: person_id
children.description: a foreign key identifier to the person for whom the specimen is recorded.

children.name: specimen_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key referring to a standard concept identifier in the standardized vocabularies for the specimen.

children.name: specimen_type_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key referring to the concept identifier in the standardized vocabularies reflecting the system of record from which the specimen was represented in the source data.

children.name: specimen_date
children.description: the date the specimen was obtained from the person.

children.name: specimen_datetime
children.description: the date and time on the date when the specimen was obtained from the person.

children.name: quantity
children.description: the amount of specimen collection from the person during the sampling procedure.

children.name: unit_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key to a standard concept identifier for the unit associated with the numeric quantity of the specimen collection.

children.name: anatomic_site_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key to a standard concept identifier for the anatomic location of specimen collection.

children.name: disease_status_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key to a standard concept identifier for the disease status of specimen collection.

children.name: specimen_source_id
children.description: the specimen identifier as it appears in the source data.

children.name: specimen_source_value
children.description: the specimen value as it appears in the source data. this value is mapped to a standard concept in the standardized vocabularies and the original code is, stored here for reference.

children.name: unit_source_value
children.description: the information about the unit as detailed in the source.

children.name: anatomic_site_source_value
children.description: the information about the anatomic site as detailed in the source.

children.name: disease_status_source_value
children.description: the information about the disease status as detailed in the source.

children.name: measurement
children.description: Grouping of measurement

children.name: measurement_id
children.description: a unique identifier for each measurement.

children.name: person_id
children.description: a foreign key identifier to the person about whom the measurement was recorded. the demographic details of that person are stored in the person table.

children.name: measurement_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key to the standard measurement concept identifier in the standardized vocabularies. these belong to the 'measurement' domain, but could overlap with the 'observation' domain (see #3 below).

children.name: measurement_date
children.description: the date of the measurement.

children.name: measurement_datetime
children.description: the date and time of the measurement. some database systems don't have a datatype of time. to accommodate all temporal analyses, datatype datetime can be used (combining measurement_date and measurement_time forum discussion)

children.name: measurement_time
children.description: the time of the measurement. this is present for backwards compatibility and will be deprecated in an upcoming version

children.name: measurement_type_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key to the predefined concept in the standardized vocabularies reflecting the provenance from where the measurement record was recorded. these belong to the 'meas type' vocabulary

children.name: operator_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key identifier to the predefined concept in the standardized vocabularies reflecting the mathematical operator that is applied to the value_as_number. operators are <, <=, =, >=, > and these concepts belong to the 'meas value operator' domain.

children.name: value_as_number
children.description: a measurement result where the result is expressed as a numeric value.

children.name: value_as_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key to a measurement result represented as a concept from the standardized vocabularies (e.g., positive/negative, present/absent, low/high, etc.). these belong to the 'meas value' domain

children.name: unit_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key to a standard concept id of measurement units in the standardized vocabularies that belong to the 'unit' domain.

children.name: range_low
children.description: the lower limit of the normal range of the measurement result. the lower range is assumed to be of the same unit of measure as the measurement value.

children.name: range_high
children.description: the upper limit of the normal range of the measurement. the upper range is assumed to be of the same unit of measure as the measurement value.

children.name: provider_id
children.description: a foreign key to the provider in the provider table who was responsible for initiating or obtaining the measurement.

children.name: visit_occurrence_id
children.description: a foreign key to the visit in the visit_occurrence table during which the measurement was recorded.

children.name: visit_detail_id
children.description: a foreign key to the visit detail in the visit_detail table during which the measurement was recorded.

children.name: measurement_source_value
children.description: the measurement name as it appears in the source data. this code is mapped to a standard concept in the standardized vocabularies and the original code is stored here for reference.

children.name: measurement_source_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key to a concept in the standard vocabularies that refers to the code used in the source.

children.name: unit_source_value
children.description: the source code for the unit as it appears in the source data. this code is mapped to a standard unit concept in the standardized vocabularies and the original code is stored here for reference.

children.name: value_source_value
children.description: the source value associated with the content of the value_as_number or value_as_concept_id as stored in the source data.

children.name: procedure_occurrence
children.description: Grouping of procedure_occurrence

children.name: procedure_occurrence_id
children.description: a system-generated unique identifier for each procedure occurrence.

children.name: person_id
children.description: a foreign key identifier to the person who is subjected to the procedure. the demographic details of that person are stored in the person table.

children.name: procedure_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key that refers to a standard procedure concept identifier in the standardized vocabularies.

children.name: procedure_date
children.description: the date on which the procedure was performed.

children.name: procedure_datetime
children.description: the date and time on which the procedure was performed.

children.name: procedure_type_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key to the predefined concept identifier in the standardized vocabularies reflecting the type of source data from which the procedure record is derived, belonging to the 'procedure type' vocabulary.

children.name: modifier_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key to a standard concept identifier for a modifier to the procedure (e.g. bilateral). these concepts are typically distinguished by 'modifier' concept classes (e.g., 'cpt4 modifier' as part of the 'cpt4' vocabulary).

children.name: quantity
children.description: the quantity of procedures ordered or administered.

children.name: provider_id
children.description: a foreign key to the provider in the provider table who was responsible for carrying out the procedure.

children.name: visit_occurrence_id
children.description: a foreign key to the visit in the visit_occurrence table during which the procedure was carried out.

children.name: visit_detail_id
children.description: a foreign key to the visit detail in the visit_detail table during which the procedure was carried out.

children.name: procedure_source_value
children.description: the source code for the procedure as it appears in the source data. this code is mapped to a standard procedure concept in the standardized vocabularies and the original code is, stored here for reference. procedure source codes are typically icd-9-proc, cpt-4, hcpcs or opcs-4 codes.

children.name: procedure_source_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key to a procedure concept that refers to the code used in the source.

children.name: modifier_source_value
children.description: the source code for the qualifier as it appears in the source data.

children.name: condition_occurrence
children.description: Grouping of condition_occurrence

children.name: condition_occurrence_id
children.description: a unique identifier for each condition occurrence event.

children.name: person_id
children.description: a foreign key identifier to the person who is experiencing the condition. the demographic details of that person are stored in the person table.

children.name: condition_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key that refers to a standard concept identifier in the standardized vocabularies belonging to the 'condition' domain.

children.name: condition_start_date
children.description: the date when the instance of the condition is recorded.

children.name: condition_start_datetime
children.description: the date and time when the instance of the condition is recorded.

children.name: condition_end_date
children.description: the date when the instance of the condition is considered to have ended.

children.name: condition_end_datetime
children.description: the date when the instance of the condition is considered to have ended.

children.name: condition_type_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key to the predefined concept identifier in the standardized vocabularies reflecting the source data from which the condition was recorded, the level of standardization, and the type of occurrence. these belong to the 'condition type' vocabulary

children.name: condition_status_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key that refers to a standard concept identifier in the standardized vocabularies reflecting the point of care at which the condition was diagnosed.

children.name: stop_reason
children.description: the reason that the condition was no longer present, as indicated in the source data.

children.name: provider_id
children.description: a foreign key to the provider in the provider table who was responsible for capturing (diagnosing) the condition.

children.name: visit_occurrence_id
children.description: a foreign key to the visit in the visit_occurrence table during which the condition was determined (diagnosed).

children.name: visit_detail_id
children.description: a foreign key to the visit in the visit_detail table during which the condition was determined (diagnosed).

children.name: condition_source_value
children.description: the source code for the condition as it appears in the source data. this code is mapped to a standard condition concept in the standardized vocabularies and the original code is stored here for reference.

children.name: condition_source_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key to a condition concept that refers to the code used in the source.

children.name: condition_status_source_value
children.description: the source code for the condition status as it appears in the source data. this code is mapped to a standard concept in the standardized vocabularies and the original code is stored here for reference.

children.name: death
children.description: Grouping of death

children.name: person_id
children.description: a foreign key identifier to the deceased person. the demographic details of that person are stored in the person table.

children.name: death_date
children.description: the date the person was deceased. if the precise date including day or month is not known or not allowed, december is used as the default month, and the last day of the month the default day.

children.name: death_datetime
children.description: the date and time the person was deceased. if the precise date including day or month is not known or not allowed, december is used as the default month, and the last day of the month the default day.

children.name: death_type_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key referring to the predefined concept identifier in the standardized vocabularies reflecting how the death was represented in the source data.

children.name: cause_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key referring to a standard concept identifier in the standardized vocabularies for conditions.

children.name: cause_source_value
children.description: the source code for the cause of death as it appears in the source data. this code is mapped to a standard concept in the standardized vocabularies and the original code is, stored here for reference.

children.name: cause_source_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key to the concept that refers to the code used in the source. note, this variable name is abbreviated to ensure it will be allowable across database platforms.

children.name: location
children.description: Grouping of location

children.name: location_id
children.description: a unique identifier for each geographic location.

children.name: address_1
children.description: the address field 1, typically used for the street address, as it appears in the source data.

children.name: address_2
children.description: the address field 2, typically used for additional detail such as buildings, suites, floors, as it appears in the source data.

children.name: city
children.description: the city field as it appears in the source data.

children.name: state
children.description: the state field as it appears in the source data.

children.name: zip
children.description: the zip or postal code.

children.name: county
children.description: the county.

children.name: location_source_value
children.description: the verbatim information that is used to uniquely identify the location as it appears in the source data.

children.name: observation
children.description: Grouping of observation

children.name: observation_id
children.description: a unique identifier for each observation.

children.name: person_id
children.description: a foreign key identifier to the person about whom the observation was recorded. the demographic details of that person are stored in the person table.

children.name: observation_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key to the standard observation concept identifier in the standardized vocabularies.

children.name: observation_date
children.description: the date of the observation.

children.name: observation_datetime
children.description: the date and time of the observation.

children.name: observation_type_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key to the predefined concept identifier in the standardized vocabularies reflecting the type of the observation.

children.name: value_as_number
children.description: the observation result stored as a number. this is applicable to observations where the result is expressed as a numeric value.

children.name: value_as_string
children.description: the observation result stored as a string. this is applicable to observations where the result is expressed as verbatim text.

children.name: value_as_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key to an observation result stored as a concept id. this is applicable to observations where the result can be expressed as a standard concept from the standardized vocabularies (e.g., positive/negative, present/absent, low/high, etc.).

children.name: qualifier_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key to a standard concept id for a qualifier (e.g., severity of drug-drug interaction alert)

children.name: unit_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key to a standard concept id of measurement units in the standardized vocabularies.

children.name: provider_id
children.description: a foreign key to the provider in the provider table who was responsible for making the observation.

children.name: visit_occurrence_id
children.description: a foreign key to the visit in the visit_occurrence table during which the observation was recorded.

children.name: visit_detail_id
children.description: a foreign key to the visit in the visit_detail table during which the observation was recorded.

children.name: observation_source_value
children.description: the observation code as it appears in the source data. this code is mapped to a standard concept in the standardized vocabularies and the original code is, stored here for reference.

children.name: observation_source_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key to a concept that refers to the code used in the source.

children.name: unit_source_value
children.description: the source code for the unit as it appears in the source data. this code is mapped to a standard unit concept in the standardized vocabularies and the original code is, stored here for reference.

children.name: qualifier_source_value
children.description: the source value associated with a qualifier to characterize the observation

children.name: observation_event_id
children.description: a foreign key to an event table (e.g., procedure_occurrence_id).

children.name: obs_event_field_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key that refers to a standard concept identifier in the standardized vocabularies referring to the field represented in the observation_event_id.

children.name: value_as_datetime
children.description: the observation result stored as a datetime value. this is applicable to observations where the result is expressed as a point in time.

children.name: observation_period
children.description: Grouping of observation_period

children.name: observation_period_id
children.description: a unique identifier for each observation period.

children.name: person_id
children.description: a foreign key identifier to the person for whom the observation period is defined. the demographic details of that person are stored in the person table.

children.name: observation_period_start_date
children.description: the start date of the observation period for which data are available from the data source.

children.name: observation_period_end_date
children.description: the end date of the observation period for which data are available from the data source.

children.name: period_type_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key identifier to the predefined concept in the standardized vocabularies reflecting the source of the observation period information

children.name: drug_exposure
children.description: Grouping of drug_exposure

children.name: drug_exposure_id
children.description: a system-generated unique identifier for each drug utilization event.

children.name: person_id
children.description: a foreign key identifier to the person who is subjected to the drug. the demographic details of that person are stored in the person table.

children.name: drug_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key that refers to a standard concept identifier in the standardized vocabularies belonging to the 'drug' domain.

children.name: drug_exposure_start_date
children.description: the start date for the current instance of drug utilization. valid entries include a start date of a prescription, the date a prescription was filled, or the date on which a drug administration procedure was recorded.

children.name: drug_exposure_start_datetime
children.description: the start date and time for the current instance of drug utilization. valid entries include a start datetime of a prescription, the date and time a prescription was filled, or the date and time on which a drug administration procedure was recorded.

children.name: drug_exposure_end_date
children.description: the end date for the current instance of drug utilization. depending on different sources, it could be a known or an inferred date and denotes the last day at which the patient was still exposed to drug.

children.name: drug_exposure_end_datetime
children.description: the end date and time for the current instance of drug utilization. depending on different sources, it could be a known or an inferred date and time and denotes the last day at which the patient was still exposed to drug.

children.name: verbatim_end_date
children.description: the known end date of a drug_exposure as provided by the source.

children.name: drug_type_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key to the predefined concept identifier in the standardized vocabularies reflecting the type of drug exposure recorded. it indicates how the drug exposure was represented in the source data and belongs to the 'drug type' vocabulary.

children.name: stop_reason
children.description: the reason the drug was stopped. reasons include regimen completed, changed, removed, etc.

children.name: refills
children.description: the number of refills after the initial prescription. the initial prescription is not counted, values start with null.

children.name: quantity
children.description: the quantity of drug as recorded in the original prescription or dispensing record.

children.name: days_supply
children.description: the number of days of supply of the medication as prescribed. this reflects the intention of the provider for the length of exposure.

children.name: sig
children.description: the directions ('signetur') on the drug prescription as recorded in the original prescription (and printed on the container) or dispensing record.

children.name: route_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key that refers to a standard concept identifier in the standardized vocabularies reflecting the route of administration and belonging to the 'route' domain.

children.name: lot_number
children.description: an identifier assigned to a particular quantity or lot of drug product from the manufacturer.

children.name: provider_id
children.description: a foreign key to the provider in the provider table who initiated (prescribed or administered) the drug exposure.

children.name: visit_occurrence_id
children.description: a foreign key to the visit in the visit_occurrence table during which the drug exposure was initiated.

children.name: visit_detail_id
children.description: a foreign key to the visit detail in the visit_detail table during which the drug exposure was initiated.

children.name: drug_source_value
children.description: the source code for the drug as it appears in the source data. this code is mapped to a standard drug concept in the standardized vocabularies and the original code is, stored here for reference.

children.name: drug_source_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key to a drug concept that refers to the code used in the source.

children.name: route_source_value
children.description: the information about the route of administration as detailed in the source.

children.name: dose_unit_source_value
children.description: the information about the dose unit as detailed in the source.

children.name: device_exposure
children.description: Grouping of device_exposure

children.name: device_exposure_id
children.description: a system-generated unique identifier for each device exposure.

children.name: person_id
children.description: a foreign key identifier to the person who is subjected to the device. the demographic details of that person are stored in the person table.

children.name: device_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key that refers to a standard concept identifier in the standardized vocabularies for the device concept.

children.name: device_exposure_start_date
children.description: the date the device or supply was applied or used.

children.name: device_exposure_start_datetime
children.description: the date and time the device or supply was applied or used.

children.name: device_exposure_end_date
children.description: the date the device or supply was removed from use.

children.name: device_exposure_end_datetime
children.description: the date and time the device or supply was removed from use.

children.name: device_type_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key to the predefined concept identifier in the standardized vocabularies reflecting the type of device exposure recorded. it indicates how the device exposure was represented in the source data.

children.name: unique_device_id
children.description: a udi or equivalent identifying the instance of the device used in the person.

children.name: quantity
children.description: the number of individual devices used for the exposure.

children.name: provider_id
children.description: a foreign key to the provider in the provider table who initiated of administered the device.

children.name: visit_occurrence_id
children.description: a foreign key to the visit in the visit table during which the device was used.

children.name: visit_detail_id
children.description: a foreign key to the visit in the visit-detail table during which the drug exposure was initiated.

children.name: device_source_value
children.description: the source code for the device as it appears in the source data. this code is mapped to a standard device concept in the standardized vocabularies and the original code is stored here for reference.

children.name: device_source_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key to a device concept that refers to the code used in the source.

children.name: note
children.description: Grouping of note

children.name: note_id
children.description: a unique identifier for each note.

children.name: person_id
children.description: a foreign key identifier to the person about whom the note was recorded. the demographic details of that person are stored in the person table.

children.name: note_event_id
children.description: a foreign key identifier to the event (e.g. measurement, procedure, visit, drug exposure, etc) record during which the note was recorded.

children.name: note_event_field_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key to the predefined concept in the standardized vocabularies reflecting the field to which the note_event_id is referring.

children.name: note_date
children.description: the date the note was recorded.

children.name: note_datetime
children.description: the date and time the note was recorded.

children.name: note_type_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key to the predefined concept in the standardized vocabularies reflecting the type, origin or provenance of the note. these belong to the 'note type' vocabulary

children.name: note_class_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key to the predefined concept in the standardized vocabularies reflecting the hl7 loinc document type vocabulary classification of the note.

children.name: note_title
children.description: the title of the note as it appears in the source.

children.name: note_text
children.description: the content of the note.

children.name: encoding_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key to the predefined concept in the standardized vocabularies reflecting the note character encoding type

children.name: language_concept_id
children.description: a foreign key to the predefined concept in the standardized vocabularies reflecting the language of the note

children.name: provider_id

children.name: visit_occurrence_id
children.description: a foreign key to the visit in the visit_occurrence table when the note was taken.

children.name: visit_detail_id
children.description: a foreign key to the visit in the visit_detail table when the note was taken.

children.name: note_source_value
